newsitem.title: USA: Brooke sells Russian real estate business.
newsitem.headline: Brooke sells Russian real estate business.

text.p: Brooke Group Ltd sold its Russian real estate development business to New Valley Corp for $55 million, the companies said in separate statements.

Bennett LeBow, the chairman and chief executive of both companies, said in a statement that the deal will allow Brooke Group to focus on the tobacco business, while letting New Valley expand its real estate operations to Russia.
Brooke Group holds a controlling stake in New Valley.
Brooke Group received $21.5 million in cash and $33.5 million in a nine percent promissory note due within a year.
BrookeMil, the name of the Russian real estate operation, is developing a three-phase office and mixed use complex on 2.2 acres of land in Moscow.
The first phase of the project is completed and leased, while it has preleased portions of its second phase and is planning to start construction of a third phase in 1998, the companies said.

New Valley said in its statement that is is negotiating a joint venture with the City of Moscow and financier and developer Donald Trump for a $175 million renovation of the Moskva Hotel, which is across the street from the Kremlin.
New Valley and its partners would have majority control of the hotel, with Moscow receiving a minority of the equity, New Valley said.
New Valley would fund the project through equity contributions and debt financing, it said.
